import json,os,re
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))

steps.input:
for i in [1,2]:
    a,b=G[f'Demo pair {i} input'],G[f'Demo pair {i} output']
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(x for row in a for x in row); bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    others=[c for c in cnt if c!=bg]
    print(i,'bg',bg,'others',sorted(others))
    # block color = most common non-bg
    blk=max((c,n) for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bg)[0]; marker=[c for c in others if c!=blk][0]
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[0])) if a[r][c]==blk]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    print('  block rows',min(rs),max(rs),'cols',min(cs),max(cs),'n',len(pts))
    mark=[(r,c) for r in range(len(a)) for c in range(len(a[0])) if a[r][c]==marker][0]
    adds=[(r,c) for r in range(len(b)) for c in range(len(b[0])) if b[r][c]==marker and a[r][c]!=marker]
    rfs=[p[0] for p in adds]; cfs=[p[1] for p in adds]
    print('  marker',mark,'fill rows',min(rfs),max(rfs),'cols',min(cfs),max(cfs),'n',len(adds))
